name: Bill Check
office_task: Check every supplier bill that lands in the ledger against its purchase order before anyone books or pays it, and put each one in exactly one queue for a person.
systems_of_record: Xero or MYOB (the ledger that issues the bill_id and holds the purchase orders)
the document store where the written variation approvals live

emits.write: an exception record on the bill naming the person who owns it: the check that failed and the checks that never ran, the difference in dollars, the source document, and its queue (needs a decision, waiting on the supplier, or blocked: no purchase order, or scope with no written approval)
emits.readback: the exception desk returns an exception_id, and reading that id back returns the bill_id, the failed check, the dollar difference, the source document and the exception_owner; no id back means nothing was raised and the run stops
